scope: Primary ModelingApp presentation only; existing public embedding retained, workspace is mount-time layout choice
sourceAuthority: Unchanged modeling-controller, engine, serializer, receiver, codecs and native provider. No prototype geometry/state copied.

groups: pinned #1835 geometry and actual React/controller/serializer/receiver imports
workspace starts with one persistent viewport and closed dimension options
Browser feature selection opens actual constrained width and height controls
typing a dimension stages only draft state and preserves the accepted display
Apply admits a real serialized edit and closes only after accepted display commit
Undo and Redo retain model history and outside-field keyboard routing
Cancel and Escape discard drafts while neutral Escape only dismisses options
provider refusal retains accepted authority, error, editable draft and open options
pending dimensions survive Inspect/Files/Limits switching, close and reopen
repeat, IME, modifier and busy keys cannot duplicate Apply or discard work
stale Apply completion cannot close a different drawer or newer dimension draft
file/STL/examples/limits remain reachable without remounting the viewport or controller
unmount while display acceptance is pending disposes once and ignores late completion
omitted workspace prop preserves the existing embedding and dimension workflow
flow.boundary: Actual mounted React and host controls, modeling controller, engine serializer, receiver and CPU scene. Controlled provider, Worker, ResizeObserver and display port. All edited replies reuse genuine #1835 baseline geometry; edited native geometry, WebGPU pixels and physical browser file/download acceptance UNRUN.

declarationBoundary.qualification: Reused unchanged #1890 emitted declarations for UI-only scope; not a fresh current CAD source emit

css.scope: CSS syntax only; no rendered pixels or layout claim

lint.scope: Three changed TSX sources and the local focused flow; warnings are test console receipts

firstFailures.cause: Four tracked app UI components absent from inherited sparse checkout, producing missing imports and dependent implicit-any diagnostics. Materialized exact base files; no product patch to them.
One new conditional action expression violated no-unused-expressions. Replaced with equivalent explicit if/else; original log preserved.

reviewCorrections: Mount-time workspace flag preserves host/controller if props change.
Visible options heading receives focus on command open; workspace receives focus on close/success. Reopened command and menu Escape also restore visible focus.
